description.short: Finds what others promised you in mail, Teams and meetings.
description.full: WOMBOT reads your mail, Teams chats and meeting transcripts and lists the commitments people made to you (and, if you ask, the ones you made): who promised what, when it is due, whether it looks done, with a link to the source. It only reads; reminders are drafts you send yourself.

localizationKeys.agent_description: Who owes me what? Finds commitments people made to you in mail, Teams chats and meetings, with status and a link to the source. Read-only.
localizationKeys.starter_all_text: Who owes me what from the last 30 days?
localizationKeys.starter_overdue_text: Which promises to me are overdue?
localizationKeys.starter_person_text: What has [name] promised me and not delivered yet?
localizationKeys.starter_meeting_text: Which action items from my last meeting about [topic] are assigned to others and still open?
localizationKeys.starter_own_text: What have I promised others that is still open?
localizationKeys.starter_reminder_text: Draft a friendly reminder for the oldest open promise to me.
